title: Demo env: add alert routing + GTM-friendly dashboards
author: Allison Grant
description: Context: We’ve had multiple demo-impacting incidents where the Console looked empty or latency/errors spiked and the field only noticed mid-call (see SUP-4189 empty dashboards + SUP-4127 429 throttling). This PR adds demo-specific dashboards and alert routing so that demo regressions page the right audience (SEs/GT-Motion) without polluting production on-call. Scope: (1) create a small set of demo environment dashboards with “is the demo healthy right now?” signals, (2) add alert rules tuned for synthetic traffic and short-lived spikes, and (3) route notifications to a GTM-friendly Slack channel with clear runbook links and ownership. What’s included: Dashboard pack ("Demo Tenant – Overview" / "Demo Tenant – API Health" / "Demo Tenant – Console Ingestion") with defaults pinned to the demo org + seeded project tags; Widgets include request rate, p50/p95/p99 latency by route, 4xx/5xx breakdown, streaming disconnect rate, quota rejections (429) by key scope, fallback events by region/model-family, and dashboard freshness (last_ingested_at lag). Alerting: new alert group "demo-env" with rules: Demo API error rate (5xx > 1% for 5m, gated by rps>0.5), Demo 429 rate (429 > 0.5% for 5m, gated by rps>1), Streaming disconnect regression (disconnects > baseline+3σ for 10m), Console ingestion lag (lag > 6m for 10m), Synthetic traffic generator missing (no heartbeat event for 10m during business hours), and Demo route pinned model unavailable (pin resolution failures > 0 for 2m). Routing: demo alerts go to Slack channel #gtm-demo-alerts (new) and @demo-oncall (Slack user group) rather than #prod-oncall. Each alert includes a short "What broke / what to do" and a runbook URL. Tuning notes: demo env is intentionally bursty (parallel demos + resets). Rules use: a) gating by RPS and business-hours schedule, b) separate severities (sev3 informational vs sev2 demo-blocking), and c) longer evaluation windows for ingestion lag to avoid false positives during reset. Ops: add a small "Demo Env Observability" README with instructions for disabling alert noise during planned maintenance and a sanity-check command to send a test alert to Slack. Follow-ups (out of scope): auto-create a dedicated PagerDuty service for demo-sev2 (currently Slack-only), and unify the per-tenant tag conventions for demo traffic across hosted/dedicated simulators (tracked in ENG-4894). Screenshots: attached in internal PR comments (Grafana/Console dashboard previews).
